name: sillytavern-every-text-line-editor
description: In-SillyTavern prompt and text source editor

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/vendor/prism-code-editor dist/vendor/diff dist/vendor/monaco-editor/min dist/vendor/monaco-spellchecker dist/vendor/typo-js/dictionaries/en_US && cp -R node_modules/prism-code-editor/dist/. dist/vendor/prism-code-editor/ && cp -R node_modules/diff/libesm/. dist/vendor/diff/ && cp -R node_modules/monaco-editor/min/. dist/vendor/monaco-editor/min/ && cp node_modules/monaco-spellchecker/lib/spellchecker.es.js dist/vendor/monaco-spellchecker/spellchecker.es.js && cp node_modules/typo-js/typo.js dist/vendor/typo-js/typo.js && cp node_modules/typo-js/dictionaries/en_US/en_US.aff dist/vendor/typo-js/dictionaries/en_US/en_US.aff && cp node_modules/typo-js/dictionaries/en_US/en_US.dic dist/vendor/typo-js/dictionaries/en_US/en_US.dic

author: IceFog72
